title: Make the existing natural paper proof genuinely natural and same fresh governed case
summary: Enforce genuine natural proof in loop-prod-tel-002 probe by requiring a fresh governed case (dev-paper-release-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}), fail closed on absent/mismatched case checksum/plan/binding/version/state, eliminate invented IDs and default versions, require explicit non-empty market input lineage (rejecting bare raw_symbol alone), verify observed source records against Postgres source evidence store (source_ingest.source_evidence) with connector and tenant scoping, anchor approved artifact checksum/version/state from registry entries with non-empty tenant match, enforce RFC-3339 timestamp windowing (t_evt <= t_obs <= t_sig) within 420s freshness window and reasonable year bounds (2024-2030), and apply Taiwan market freshness rules when applicable. In natural mode the wrapper script never invokes hosted_lifecycle_stimulus. Controlled-stimulus mode remains available and clearly labelled.
